verdict.rationale: Rippling's developer docs mention a sandbox environment and developer documentation (rippling-docs-8, rippling-probe-1) plus a CLI for building integrations (rippling-gh-1), suggesting some ability to test API calls, but there is no evidence of an actual interactive API reference (e.g., Swagger/OpenAPI explorer) with embedded runnable code examples. Missing for 10: explicit interactive API explorer UI, runnable code snippets/try-it-now console, language-specific SDK examples.
